Reader API

The reader converts supported inputs into markdown, metadata, chunks, and warnings for agents.

read_html

Use read_html when the caller already has a trusted HTML string.

let result = read_html(html, Some(base_url), &options)?;

Options

Options control extraction mode, link retention, image retention, chunking, and query focus.

OptionPurpose
target_selectorLimit rendering to one CSS selector.
remove_selectorsRemove page noise before extraction.
